posts.author: finkd
posts.text: Introducing Muse Wonder, our new family of frontier models with state of the art performance for personal and professional agentic work. https://t.co/NKHrybrGKQ

posts.author: AIatMeta
posts.text:
We’re excited to introduce the Muse Wonder series with Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, our most capable models yet. Both are frontier models, built to deliver state-of-the-art performance for personal and professional agentic tasks.

Muse Wonder is available today via the Meta Model API and Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full is available today for Muse Code subscribers. Muse Wonder will also soon power experiences in our personal agent product, Muse, rolling out first to subscribers.

posts.author: ArtificialAnlys
posts.text:
Meta has released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, achieving Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 scores of 52 and 56 at max reasoning effort - each a material gain over Muse Spark 1.3 (max) at 48, with a release gap of only 6 weeks

Muse Wonder is available for users on Meta’s first-party API, while Muse Wonder Full is currently only available for Muse Code users.

posts.author: finkd
posts.text:
It's been just over a year since we started Meta Superintelligence Labs. Muse Spark was our first family of models, and now Muse Wonder is a much larger and more advanced class of models that brings us to the frontier.
We're releasing two models today. Muse Wonder for fast frontier performance and Muse Wonder Full for the full version of the model.

posts.author: TechCrunch AI
posts.text: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder. Meta's Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, the company's first attempt at a frontier model.

posts.author: AIatMeta
posts.text:
Two things make Muse Wonder suited for long-running, multi-step work an agent faces every day:

-> Active Memory carries your context across conversations and surfaces it when it's relevant.

-> Active Focus keeps the models working toward your goal when a task gets challenging, trying alternative approaches, working through blockers, and following through to completion.

posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Microsoft plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027. Microsoft will make its in-house Azure Maia chips the main AI inference system across its products starting in 2027, deploying them at multi-gigawatt scale. The upcoming Maia 300 should deliver 40 percent more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems. CEO Satya Nadella calls it "our biggest bet yet on our own silicon." The article Microsoft plans to scale its own Maia AI chips to gigawatt levels by 2027 appeared first on The Decoder .
